subject: Third outage this month
body: This is the third time this month the dashboard has gone down during business hours. Our renewal is in six weeks and at this point I'm recommending we don't sign.

subject: Cancelling unless this is fixed
body: If the CSV export is still broken on Monday we're cancelling. We've been waiting two weeks.

subject: Done with this
body: Honestly I'm done. Charged me twice, support took four days to answer, and it's still wrong. Close my account.

subject: Evaluating alternatives
body: We've started a trial with a competitor. Before we commit, is there any plan to fix the permissions model? That's the blocker for us.

subject: Not renewing
body: Please note we will not be renewing in March. The product hasn't kept up with what we need.

subject: Last chance
body: I've raised this ticket three times now. Fix it this week or we move our 40 seats elsewhere.

subject: Losing patience
body: Two months of promises about the API rate limits. My team has stopped using the integration entirely. I'm putting the renewal on hold.

subject: Refund and close
body: I want a full refund for this month and my account closed. This has been a waste of time.

subject: How do I cancel?
body: Hi - where in the settings do I cancel my subscription? I'm switching to the annual plan and want to end the monthly one first.
hard: Says 'cancel' but is an upgrade, not a threat.

subject: Cancel one seat
body: One of our team members left. How do I cancel just her seat without affecting the others?
hard: 'Cancel' scoped to a seat, not the account.

subject: Cancellation policy
body: Before we sign the annual contract - what's your cancellation policy if we need to stop mid-term?
hard: A pre-sales question containing every churn keyword.

subject: Cancelled by mistake
body: I cancelled my plan last night by accident and now I can't get back in. Can you restore it?
hard: Already cancelled, wants to stay - the opposite of a threat.

subject: Did my cancellation go through?
body: I requested cancellation two weeks ago but I was charged again today. Can you check?
hard: Past cancellation plus a billing error; the threat has already happened.

subject: This is really frustrating
body: Every time I upload a file over 50MB it fails silently. No error, nothing. I've lost an afternoon to this.
hard: Angry tone, no churn signal at all.

subject: Come on
body: The search has been returning stale results for a week. How is this not fixed yet?

subject: Disappointed
body: I expected better for the price. The reporting is very basic compared to what the sales page implied.
hard: Dissatisfaction that could precede churn but does not state it.

subject: Fourth time asking
body: Fourth time asking about SSO. Is it on the roadmap or not? A straight answer would be nice.

subject: Charged twice
body: I was charged twice for October. Same amount, two days apart. Invoice numbers 88123 and 88140.

subject: Invoice for accounting
body: Could you send last month's invoice as a PDF? Our accountant needs it for the quarter close.

subject: VAT number missing
body: Our invoices don't show our VAT number. We need it there for reclaim. Where do I add it?

subject: Card declined
body: Got an email saying my payment failed but the card works everywhere else. What's going on?

subject: Unexpected charge
body: There's a 240 EUR charge I don't recognise. We're on the 99/month plan. Can you explain it?

subject: Prorated refund?
body: We downgraded halfway through the month. Do we get a prorated refund for the difference?

subject: Switch to annual billing
body: We'd like to move to annual billing to get the discount. What's the process?

subject: Receipt email going to the wrong person
body: Receipts are going to a colleague who left. How do I change the billing contact?

subject: 502 on every request
body: Since about 09:00 CET every API call returns 502. Nothing on your status page. This is blocking our whole pipeline.

subject: Webhooks stopped
body: Webhooks stopped firing around midnight. No config changes on our side. Endpoint is up and responding 200 to manual posts.

subject: Slow queries
body: Reports that used to load in 2s now take 40s. Same filters, same data volume. Started Tuesday.

subject: Export produces empty file
body: Steps: open Reports, select last 30 days, click Export CSV. File downloads but is 0 bytes. Chrome 141, macOS. Happens every time.

subject: Timezone wrong in digest
body: The daily digest email says 09:00 but arrives at 06:00. Our workspace is set to Europe/Berlin.

subject: Mobile app crashes on login
body: iOS app crashes immediately after entering the password. Reinstalled twice. iPhone 15, iOS 19.2.

subject: Duplicate notifications
body: We're getting every notification three times since the last release. Started Thursday.

subject: Search ignores filters
body: When I filter by owner and then search, the filter is ignored and I get everything back.

subject: Data looks wrong
body: The totals on the overview don't match the detail view. Overview says 1,204, detail adds to 1,197. Which one is right?

subject: Locked out
body: MFA device died and the backup codes are on it. I can't get into the admin account and nobody else has admin.

subject: Add five seats
body: We're onboarding five people on Monday. Can you add the seats now and bill us on the next cycle?

subject: Transfer ownership
body: The account owner has left the company. How do we transfer ownership to me? I'm CC'ing our IT lead.

subject: Remove ex-employee
body: Please remove j.walsh@ immediately, he left today. I've already revoked his SSO but he still shows as active.

subject: SSO setup
body: We're rolling out Okta. Is there a SAML metadata URL we should point at, or do we upload a certificate?

subject: Password reset loop
body: Reset link says expired the moment I click it. Tried three times, different browsers.

subject: Two accounts merged?
body: We seem to have two workspaces with the same domain. Can they be merged, and what happens to the data?

subject: Student discount?
body: Do you have a student discount? I'm doing a masters and paying out of pocket.
hard: Reads as billing but is really a sales question; a classifier without a catch-all forces it.

subject: Is there an API for this?
body: Is there an API endpoint to list all projects with their owners? I can only find the per-project one.

subject: Keyboard shortcuts
body: Is there a list of keyboard shortcuts anywhere? The help centre doesn't seem to have one.

subject: Dark mode
body: Any chance of a dark mode? My team works late and the white background is rough.

subject: GDPR / data location
body: Where is our data stored physically? Our legal team needs to know before we expand usage.

subject: Partnership enquiry
body: We build integrations for logistics companies and would like to discuss listing on your marketplace. Who should I talk to?

subject: Bulk import template
body: Is there a CSV template for bulk importing contacts? I want to get the columns right before I try.

subject: Training for new hires
body: We have eight new people starting. Do you run onboarding sessions or is it all self-serve?

subject: Billing bug?
body: Our invoice shows 12 seats but we only have 9 users. Either the billing is wrong or the seat count is buggy. Either way we're being overcharged.
hard: Genuinely both a billing issue and a bug; routing is a judgement call.

subject: Slow and expensive
body: Reports take 30 seconds and we just got upgraded to the next pricing tier without warning. Both of these are problems.
hard: Two issues, two teams. Whichever way it routes, half is wrong.

subject: Might have to reconsider
body: The integration has been unreliable all quarter. I'm not threatening anything, but I do have to justify this spend internally.
hard: Explicitly denies threatening while describing exactly that.

subject: Just venting
body: Ignore me, I'm just venting - but the new navigation is awful and everyone on my team hates it.
hard: Strong negative sentiment, explicitly not a request.

subject: Asking for a friend
body: A colleague is having trouble with exports. He's on a different workspace. Can you help him or does he need to write in himself?
hard: Reported third-hand; the bug is real but not this account's.

subject: Renewal question
body: Our renewal quote came in 22% higher than last year. Can you explain the increase? We budgeted for flat.
hard: Renewal friction without a churn statement.

subject: Escalating internally
body: I've escalated this to our CTO. The data discrepancy from last week is still unexplained and he wants an answer before the board meeting.
hard: 'Escalating' sounds like churn language but is internal.

subject: Competitor comparison
body: Your competitor does incremental sync. Do you? It came up in our review and I want to give an accurate answer.
hard: Mentions a competitor without any intent to leave.

subject: Trial ending
body: Our trial ends Friday. We haven't managed to get the import working so we can't really evaluate it. What now?
hard: Not a customer yet; losing them still counts as churn.

subject: down?
body: is it down

subject: invoice
body: need invoice pls

subject: broken
body: export broken again
why was i charged

subject: cancel
body: cancel
hard: One word, no context. Genuinely ambiguous; treated as a threat because the downside is asymmetric.

subject: Problem with payment
body: Hello, we have make the payment but system say not paid. Please to check. Thank you.

subject: Not working since update
body: After last update the report is not more working. Before was ok. We need this for the client urgent.

subject: Request for stop service
body: We want stop the service at end of month, please confirm what we must do.

subject: Question about the users
body: How many users we can add in our plan? We are 14 persons now and maybe 20 next month.

subject: Thanks
body: Just wanted to say the new filters are great. Saved us a lot of clicking.

subject: Quick win suggestion
body: Small thing: it would help if the date picker remembered the last range. Not urgent at all.

subject: Working now
body: Ignore my last ticket, it started working again after I cleared the cache. Sorry for the noise.

subject: Renewed
body: We've renewed for another year. Could you send the updated contract to legal@?
hard: Contains 'renew' in the positive direction.

subject: Refund for the failed month
body: The service was unusable for eleven days in November. We'd like that month credited.

subject: Double charge refund
body: Please refund the duplicate charge from the 3rd. Happy otherwise, just need the money back.

subject: Refund policy
body: If we cancel mid-year do we get the unused months back, or is it non-refundable?
hard: Asks about refunds without requesting one.

subject: Charged after cancelling
body: I cancelled in August and was charged in September and October. I want both refunded.

subject: Accidental annual purchase
body: I clicked annual instead of monthly. Can I get the difference back or switch it?

subject: Suspicious login
body: We got an alert about a login from a country none of our team is in. Can you confirm and show us the session log?

subject: SOC 2 report
body: Our security review needs your latest SOC 2 Type II. Where do we request it?

subject: API key leaked
body: One of our engineers committed an API key to a public repo. We've rotated it but can you confirm no calls were made with the old one?

subject: Data deletion request
body: A former customer has asked us to delete their records. Is there a hard-delete, or is it soft only?

subject: Ongoing issues - summary
body: I want to lay out everything that has happened since September because I don't think anyone has the full picture. First, the migration tool lost about 400 records - we caught it ourselves. Then the API limits changed without notice and broke our nightly job for four days. Support closed that ticket as resolved when it wasn't. Last week the dashboard was down twice. I have spent more time managing this vendor relationship than using the product. I'd like someone senior to call me this week.
hard: Long, no explicit cancellation, but unmistakable churn risk.

subject: Feature request with context
body: Some background: we run about 200 campaigns a quarter and each needs approval from two people. Right now we track that in a spreadsheet next to your tool, which is obviously silly. What we want is a simple two-step approval on records. I know you have workflows on the enterprise tier but we can't justify that jump for one feature. Is there anything in between, or on the roadmap?

subject: Migration gone wrong
body: We migrated 12,000 records on Saturday following your guide exactly. About 900 came through with empty custom fields, and a handful have the wrong owner. The rest look fine. I have the import log if that helps. We need this resolved before Thursday when the team comes back.

subject: (no subject)
body: see attached
hard: No usable content; any confident classification is wrong.

subject: Fwd: Fwd: RE: issue
body: Any update on this?
hard: Follow-up with no context.

subject: test
body: test ticket please ignore

subject: Rate limited unexpectedly
body: We're getting 429s at around 40 requests a second, but our plan says 100. Has the limit changed?

subject: Attachments not loading
body: Attachments show as broken images in the activity feed. Downloading them directly works fine.

subject: Sync stuck
body: The Salesforce sync has said 'in progress' for 18 hours. Restarting it does nothing.

subject: Emails going to spam
body: Our notification emails from your domain are landing in spam for everyone at our company since Monday.

subject: Wrong currency
body: Prices show in USD even though our workspace is set to EUR. The invoice is in EUR, so it's just the UI.

subject: Bulk delete removed too much
body: I bulk-deleted 30 archived records and it took out 300. Is there any way to restore? This is bad.

subject: Permissions leak
body: A viewer-role user can see the billing page. That shouldn't be possible and our compliance team is asking.

subject: Downgrade before renewal
body: We want to drop from 30 seats to 18 before the renewal date. Can that be done now or only at renewal?
hard: Shrinking usage; a churn signal without a threat.

subject: Pause the account
body: Can we pause our subscription for three months? We're between funding rounds and need to cut costs.
hard: Not a threat in tone, but a genuine churn risk worth escalating.

subject: PO number on invoices
body: Our finance system needs a PO number on every invoice. Can that be added to the template?

subject: Change billing country
body: We've incorporated in Ireland now. How do we update the billing entity and country?

subject: Annual invoice early
body: Could we get next year's invoice issued in December rather than January? It helps our budget cycle.

subject: Seat count wrong after removal
body: I removed two users a week ago but we're still being billed for them. Does it only take effect at renewal?

subject: Nothing works and nobody answers
body: Ticket 4412 - no reply in six days. Ticket 4398 - closed without a fix. Meanwhile the sync is still broken. I don't know what else to do here.
hard: No cancellation word anywhere; the churn risk is in the exhaustion.

subject: Small typo
body: There's a typo on the billing page - 'recieve' should be 'receive'. Whenever you get a chance.
